remarks: Experience the perfect blend of historic charm and modern living in this beautifully renovated 1840 home, ideally located in one of the most desirable in-town neighborhoods. Fully restored in 2013, this classic New England property features timeless architectural details alongside thoughtful updates throughout. Step inside to find sun-filled rooms, warm hardwood floors, and high-end finishes that create a welcoming and sophisticated atmosphere. The updated kitchen boasts premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and a seamless flow into the living and dining areas-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. With three  finished levels, this home offers four spacious bedrooms, including a versatile lower-level suite perfect for guests, a home office, or au pair quarters. Bonus spaces on the lower and third floors provide flexibility for a gym, media room, or playroom.   Enjoy outdoor living in the professionally landscaped yard with a private stone patio and a stunning outdoor fireplace-perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. A charming two-story red barn adds additional storage or workshop potential. Explore the vibrant downtown, featuring upscale shops and diverse dining  options, or take a walk to nearby Waveny Park with its scenic trails and expansive green spaces. Situated in a top-rated school district and close to two train stations, this turnkey property seamlessly blends historic charm with modern convenience.
